summary_en: Run a deal from offer to closing — forms, e-signature, compliance, commissions.
summary_fr: Piloter une vente de l'offre à l'acte — pièces, signature, conformité, commissions.

tools.name: Adapt Immo
tools.positioning: A long-established French agency suite covering transaction, rental management and the agency website.
tools.description: Adapt Immo provides French agencies with transaction software, rental management, websites and portal publishing, sold as an integrated suite with training and support aimed at independent agencies and small networks.
tools.real_estate_use: Many French agencies run transaction and gérance side by side under the same carte professionnelle. Keeping both in one suite avoids the duplicate owner and property records that appear when an agency buys a sales tool and a separate rental tool — a recurring source of error at the point where a managed property goes up for sale.
features: Transaction management with mandates and matching
Rental management with leases, receipts and owner accounts
Agency website and portal publishing
Prospecting and pige modules
Electronic signature integration
Document and legal file management

use_cases.job: Run transaction and rental management on shared owner and property records
Publish mandates to portals and the agency site from one catalogue

tools.name: Apimo
tools.positioning: The French transaction system built for agencies that sell across borders — multilingual, multi-currency, open API.
tools.description: Apimo is a real estate CRM and transaction platform used by French and international agencies: listings and contacts, mandates, matching, multilingual publishing to portals in several countries, websites, and a documented open API.
tools.real_estate_use: Agencies on the Côte d'Azur, in the Alps or in border regions sell to buyers who do not read French, through portals in several countries. Apimo handles a listing in multiple languages and currencies from one record, which removes the duplicate-catalogue problem that breaks most domestic tools as soon as a second market appears.
features: Multilingual and multi-currency listing management
Publishing to French and international portals
Mandate management and buyer matching
Website generation from the catalogue
Documented open API for integrations
Rental and seasonal rental modules

use_cases.job: Market one property in several languages and currencies without duplicating the record
Publish to French and foreign portals from a single catalogue

tools.name: BoldTrail BackOffice (Brokermint)
tools.positioning: Where a closed transaction becomes a commission calculation, an agent statement and an accounting entry.
tools.description: Brokermint — now sold as BoldTrail BackOffice — handles the brokerage side of a deal: commission plans, splits, caps, fees, agent billing, 1099 preparation and accounting export. Transaction management and e-signature sit alongside it so the same file feeds both compliance and money.
tools.real_estate_use: The problem it solves is that commission structures are individually negotiated. A brokerage encodes each agent's split, cap and fee schedule once, and every closing then produces a disbursement authorisation and an agent statement automatically. Year-end 1099 preparation stops being a spreadsheet exercise.
features: Commission plans with splits, caps, tiers and referral fees
Automatic disbursement authorisations and agent statements
Agent billing for monthly fees and chargebacks
Transaction management with document checklists and e-signature
QuickBooks export and accounting reconciliation
Production reporting by agent, office and team

use_cases.job: Calculate every agent's commission automatically from their negotiated plan
Produce year-end 1099s and agent statements without rebuilding a spreadsheet

tools.name: Crexi
tools.positioning: A CRE marketplace that also runs the deal — listing, bidding, due diligence room and comps in one place.
tools.description: Crexi combines a commercial listing marketplace with transaction tooling: offer management, an auction platform, a virtual deal room, and Crexi Intelligence for sales comparables, ownership records and lease data. It positions itself as the challenger to the incumbent CoStar and LoopNet pairing.
tools.real_estate_use: A broker lists an asset, receives structured offers or runs a timed auction, and shares due-diligence documents through a permissioned data room instead of a shared drive link. Buyers use Crexi Intelligence to check what comparable assets traded for and who owns the building next door before committing to underwriting.
features: Commercial listing marketplace across asset classes
Structured offer submission and auction platform
Permissioned virtual due-diligence rooms
Crexi Intelligence comparables, ownership and lease data
Broker CRM and buyer activity analytics
Marketing tools including flyers and email campaigns

use_cases.job: Run a competitive bid process on an asset with a controlled document room
Check sale comparables and ownership before underwriting an acquisition

tools.name: Docusign
tools.positioning: The e-signature the US real estate transaction standardised on, now extended into contract lifecycle management.
tools.description: Docusign provides electronic signature, document generation, contract lifecycle management and notarisation. In real estate it is distributed both directly and through association-branded editions bundled with transaction platforms.
tools.real_estate_use: In the United States, the purchase agreement, addenda and disclosures are almost always signed here, often from inside dotloop, SkySlope or a forms platform rather than from Docusign's own interface. On the commercial side, contract lifecycle management is used for lease negotiation and clause approval across a portfolio.
features: Electronic signature with audit trail and authentication options
Templates and reusable document packages
Contract lifecycle management with clause libraries
Remote online notarisation in supported jurisdictions
Deep integration into real estate transaction platforms
API and connectors across business software

use_cases.job: Get a purchase agreement and its addenda signed from inside the transaction platform
Manage lease negotiation and clause approval across a portfolio

capabilities: Contract clause extraction and risk review

tools.name: dotloop
tools.positioning: The transaction workspace where agent, client, broker and cooperating side edit and sign the same set of documents.
tools.description: dotloop organises a deal as a "loop" — one shared workspace holding the contract set, the people, the tasks and the audit trail. Forms are filled with reusable data, signed electronically inside the product, and reviewed by a broker against a compliance checklist before the file is archived.
tools.real_estate_use: From accepted offer to closing, everything a state or association form requires lives in the loop. The agent edits a purchase agreement without leaving the browser, the buyer signs on a phone, and the broker's compliance reviewer sees at a glance which documents are missing before commission is released. Its value shows up in audit season.
features: Loops holding documents, participants, tasks and messages per transaction
Built-in form editing with association and state form libraries
Legally binding e-signature with full audit trail
Broker compliance review queues and document checklists
Templates per transaction type and per office
Activity log and archived record retention

use_cases.job: Get a full contract package prepared, signed and stored without printing anything
Review every file against a compliance checklist before releasing commission

tools.name: Hektor
tools.positioning: One of the reference transaction systems for French agencies — mandate, matching, portal publishing and website in a single subscription.
tools.description: Hektor is La Boîte Immo's real estate software for French agencies and networks: property and contact records, mandate management, automated buyer matching, portal publishing, electronic signature, and an agency website generated from the same catalogue.
tools.real_estate_use: A French agency's daily cycle runs on the mandate. Hektor holds the signed mandate and its legal mentions, matches each new listing against registered buyer criteria and sends the alert, publishes to the portals the agency subscribes to, and feeds the agency site. The reason it is bought as a suite is that in France the website and the portal feed are the same catalogue.
features: Property and mandate management with French legal mentions
Buyer criteria matching with automatic alerts
Multi-portal publishing from one catalogue
Agency website generated from the same listings
Electronic signature on mandates and offers
Pige and prospecting modules

use_cases.job: Match a new mandate against registered buyers and alert them the same day
Run listings, portal feeds and the agency website from one catalogue

tools.name: ICS
tools.positioning: Independent French software suite for property administrators, used daily by more than 18,000 professionals across cloud-based syndic, management, rental and transaction modules.
tools.description: ICS is a French software suite built for administrateurs de biens, covering condominium syndic management, property management, rental management and sales transactions. It is delivered as cloud applications accessible from a standard web browser, with servers hosted in a Class IV datacenter.
tools.real_estate_use: Property management firms and syndics in France use ICS to run their daily back office: co-ownership accounting, fund calls and general assembly administration through the syndic module, rental portfolio tracking through the gestion and location modules, and sales file follow-up through the transaction module. Because it runs in the cloud, staff access the same accounting and extra-accounting environment from any browser without maintaining local servers or a VPN.
features: Cloud-based access to accounting and extra-accounting environment via web browser
Syndic module for condominium accounting and general assembly management
Gestion module for property management portfolios
Location module for rental management
Transaction module for sales transaction tracking
Hosting in a Class IV datacenter with audited backup strategy

use_cases.job: Manage condominium accounting, fund calls and general assemblies from a cloud application
Administer rental and managed property portfolios without on-premise IT infrastructure
Track sales transactions within the same software suite used for management and syndic activity

tools.name: Immofacile
tools.positioning: A French agency package sold module by module, so a small agency buys only the trade it practises.
tools.description: Immofacile provides French real estate professionals with transaction software, rental management and syndic modules, portal publishing, agency websites and document management, packaged so an agency subscribes only to the activities it holds.
tools.real_estate_use: Small French agencies rarely practise all three regulated activities, and paying for a full administration suite to run transaction alone is a common source of overspend. Modular pricing is the practical argument here, with the option to add gérance later without migrating the client and property records.
features: Modular transaction, rental and syndic activities
Mandate management and buyer matching
Portal publishing and agency website
Owner and tenant document management
Electronic signature integration
Accounting for the modules subscribed

use_cases.job: Subscribe only to the regulated activities the agency actually practises
Add rental management later without migrating existing records

tools.name: Lone Wolf Transactions
tools.positioning: The transaction product distributed by associations — for many US agents it is the forms platform that comes with membership.
tools.description: Lone Wolf Transactions, built on the former TransactionDesk and zipForm lineage, is widely provided as a member benefit through state and local REALTOR associations. It covers forms, e-signature (Authentisign), transaction folders and broker review, and connects to Lone Wolf's brokerage accounting products.
tools.real_estate_use: Because association distribution puts it in front of a very large share of US agents, it is often the default place a purchase agreement is drafted. A brokerage then layers broker review on top and pushes closed-deal data into Lone Wolf Back Office for commission calculation, so the same file drives both compliance and payroll.
features: zipForm and TransactionDesk form libraries via association membership
Authentisign e-signature
Transaction folders with broker review and compliance status
Templates and clause libraries per office
Handoff to Lone Wolf Back Office for commission accounting
MLS data prefill into forms

use_cases.job: Draft the state-approved contract set that came with association membership
Move a closed file straight into commission disbursement without re-keying

tools.name: Modelo
tools.positioning: French real estate legal drafting kept current with the law — mandates, leases and offers generated rather than copied from an old file.
tools.description: Modelo produces legal documents for French real estate professionals: mandates, purchase offers, compromis, leases and their annexes, generated from a clause library maintained against current legislation, with electronic signature and file management.
tools.real_estate_use: French real estate law changes often enough that the biggest documentary risk in an agency is the template someone saved in 2019. Modelo's proposition is that the clause library is maintained centrally: when a legal obligation changes, the generated document changes, and the agency does not have to notice.
features: Legally maintained clause library for French real estate documents
Mandate, offer, compromis and lease generation
Annex assembly including mandatory disclosures
Electronic signature integration
Document file management per transaction
Updates tracking legislative change

use_cases.job: Produce a mandate or compromis that reflects the law as it stands today
Generate leases and annexes with the current mandatory disclosures attached

tools.name: Netty
tools.positioning: Software and website sold as one product, with the agency site treated as a lead-generation asset rather than a brochure.
tools.description: Netty provides French agencies with transaction software — listings, contacts, mandates, matching, portal publishing — combined with a website builder, SEO tooling, electronic signature and rental management modules.
tools.real_estate_use: Independent French agencies compete with national networks whose brand carries the online traffic. Netty's positioning answers that: the agency site is built for local search visibility, and every enquiry it produces lands in the same system as the mandate and the portal leads, so an independent can measure whether its own site is out-earning its portal subscriptions.
features: Transaction management with mandates and matching
Agency website with SEO structures and lead capture
Multi-portal publishing and feed management
Rental management and lease modules
Electronic signature integration
Prospecting and pige tooling

use_cases.job: Measure whether the agency's own website out-earns its portal subscriptions
Publish a new mandate to every portal and the agency site in one action

tools.name: Qualia
tools.positioning: Title and escrow production software where the lender, the agent and the buyer work inside the same closing file.
tools.description: Qualia is a title, escrow and closing platform: order management and title production, escrow accounting and reconciliation, document generation, a secure portal for all parties, remote online notarisation and digital closings, plus a marketplace of title services.
tools.real_estate_use: A US closing coordinates a title agent, a lender, two brokerages and a buyer, historically through email and fax. Qualia gives them one file: the buyer uploads identity documents and wiring instructions through a secure portal — which is also the main defence against wire fraud, the industry's most expensive failure — and escrow accounting reconciles inside the same system.
features: Title order management and production workflow
Escrow accounting with three-way reconciliation
Secure multi-party closing portal with document exchange
Wire fraud protection and verified wiring instructions
Remote online notarisation and digital closing
Marketplace for title search and settlement services

use_cases.job: Run title production and escrow accounting in one auditable system
Track a closing file and its outstanding conditions without email chains

tools.name: SkySlope
tools.positioning: Built for the broker's compliance problem first, and the agent's paperwork second.
tools.description: SkySlope is a transaction and compliance platform for brokerages, with digital forms (SkySlope Forms), e-signature (DigiSign), offer management (Offers) and broker audit workflows. Its centre of gravity is the file review queue rather than the agent experience.
tools.real_estate_use: A brokerage with a legal obligation to retain complete files uses SkySlope to enforce what "complete" means. Each transaction type carries a required-document checklist, files route to a reviewer, rejections come back with a reason, and the archive survives a state audit years later. Listing and sale files are separated so a listing that never sells is still auditable.
features: Broker file review with per-transaction-type document checklists
SkySlope Forms with state and association form libraries
DigiSign e-signature bound to the transaction file
Offers — structured offer submission and comparison for listing agents
Commission and back-office module
Retention-grade archive with full audit history

use_cases.job: Guarantee that every closed file is audit-complete before it is archived
Collect and compare multiple offers on a listing in a structured view

tools.name: SweepBright
tools.positioning: A mobile-first agency CRM for European markets — capture a property on site, publish it before leaving.
tools.description: SweepBright is a real estate agency platform used across Belgium, France and other European markets: property and contact management, mobile listing capture with photos, matching, multi-portal publishing, digital signature and an agency website module.
tools.real_estate_use: The design assumption is that the agent is never at a desk. Capturing the property during the valuation visit — rooms, photos, description — and publishing directly from the phone compresses a two-day cycle into the appointment itself, which matters most in competitive markets where the first published listing gets the enquiries.
features: Mobile property capture with photos and details on site
Contact management and buyer matching
Multi-portal publishing across European portals
Agency website module fed by the same catalogue
Digital signature on mandates and offers
Team activity and pipeline reporting

use_cases.job: Capture and publish a new listing from the phone during the valuation visit
Run a multi-country European agency on one catalogue and one portal feed

tools.name: Yousign
tools.positioning: European electronic signature with eIDAS qualification — the French default where a signature must hold in a French court.
tools.description: Yousign is a French electronic signature and contract platform: simple, advanced and qualified signature levels under eIDAS, identity verification, approval workflows, templates, audit trails and an API, with data hosted in the European Union.
tools.real_estate_use: Mandates, lease agreements, offers and état des lieux are all signed remotely now, and the question that matters is evidentiary weight. eIDAS levels are not decoration: a qualified signature carries a legal presumption a simple one does not. French agency software integrates Yousign for exactly that reason, alongside the EU hosting requirement many professional bodies impose.
features: Simple, advanced and qualified eIDAS signature levels
Signer identity verification
Reusable document templates and signature workflows
Legally admissible audit trail per signature
API and connectors to business software
European Union data hosting

use_cases.job: Have a mandate or offer signed remotely with a signature that holds legally
Sign leases and état des lieux with tenants without a physical appointment
